svg.aria-label: Agent Hub drawn as a circuit board. Phone, tablet and laptop reach the Hub on your PC over a private Tailscale network. The Hub has a 3D board and Agent Smith, the voice you talk to. Smith sends each ask through the router, which picks the cheapest thing that can answer, and calls Neo, who designs new agents from a plain description, and the Doctor, who repairs the Hub as a mission you approve. From the router: autonomous LLM missions (missions, dispatch, a private worktree, review, apply), PC control through Windows MCP, the media vault, and the git graph.
svg.text: Nothing is exposed to the internet.
Runs on OpenCode, Claude Code or a local model. Your repo is untouched until you press APPLY.
Smith calls Neo. You describe a job; Neo designs one agent file; you read it and save it; the orchestrator can pick it.
Smith calls the Doctor. A mission on the Hub's own repo, in a private copy. Restarting stays yours.
say it, or ASK THE DOCTOR
a fix in a private copy
Windows only. Smith hands it to the desktop agent. Shell and registry tools are switched off.
Runs on your PC; copy results to your phone.
One dot per project, read straight from git, including the copies agents are working in.
re-plan if the review asks for it
